name: trigger_transcript
description:
Start transcription for one audio or video asset when its transcription state is idle or error.
- This tool is idempotent: complete, no_audio, splitting_audio, uploading, and transcribing states are returned unchanged and do not start another run.
- If prepared transcription audio already exists, it is reused without another upload.
- If audio preparation/upload is still needed, ChatCut asks the open Web or Desktop editor to run its native transcription pipeline. The source must be available to that editor.
- Every started run performs Gemini language detection before ASR provider routing. The call returns after starting the work; use track_progress target=transcription to inspect it.

asset.description: Audio/video asset ID or unambiguous ID prefix.

projectId.description: Existing project ID from the editor URL or list_projects. Pass this when continuing work on an existing project and the external MCP session is not already targeted.
